title: ISP quest act
description: One act of the quest spine (docs/QUEST_SPINE.md). An act is a sequence of steps told by one narrator role; each step has a brief, an objective made of conditions on corporation state, and what is said when it is done. Quests never grant unlocks or credits of their own: the milestone ladder and the contracts do that.

narrator.description: Who tells this act, as a role. The client resolves the role to a character (name, title, portrait) from one registry, today public/scripts/liaison.js. Text never names the character; it uses {{speaker.name}}.

ladder.description: The span of the milestone ladder (data/milestones.json) this act walks: the corporation level it opens at and the level that closes it.

opensWhen.description: The act opens when any of these holds.

handoff.description: The answer to 'what now?' when the act ends: the next act, and at least one objective and one pending outcome the player can see.

role.description: Speaker roles. 'coordinator' is the Bureau officer assigned to every new corporation. New roles are added here and in the registry together.

metric.description: The milestone ladder's metric vocabulary (server/gameState.js resolveMetric: stat:, employeeCount, miningLease:, building:, building-count:, totalMined:, unlockedTech:) plus the kinds this design proposes adding to that same resolver, each reading a state field that exists today: level (corp.level), walkthroughCompleted (playerProfile.walkthroughCompleted), missionActive:<id> (corp.activeMissions), missionCompleted:<id> (corp.completedMissions), dockedAt:<stationId> (corp.currentStationId), techQueued:<techId> (queues.corporateRnD), extractorsRunning (corp.mining.silicateExtractors[].active), stationStock:<stationId>:<item> (corp.inventory).

pendingSource.description: A timer that already exists in corporation state: corp.mining.silicateExtractors[].endsAt, queues.corporateRnD[].startedAt + durationHours, corp.travel.arrivesAt, corp.contractOfferings.nextRefreshAt, corp.offices[].rentedUntil. Later acts add refinery, fabrication and expedition timers the same way.

brief.description: Shown once, when the step opens. Not shown at all when skipIfAlreadyMet applies.

objective.description: Done when every condition in 'all' holds, or any condition in 'any' holds. The label is what the objective card shows.

progress.description: A number to show against a target on the objective card, when the objective itself is a yes or no.

hints.description: One-line nudges shown on the objective card while their condition holds. Never a popup.

guide.description: Where the objective card's Go button takes the player, in the walkthrough's shape (public/scripts/walkthrough.js): a tab and the element to highlight.

uses.description: The systems in the build this step relies on: route paths after /api/accounts/:accountId/ or /api/, and data files. tests/schema/quest-spine.test.js fails if one stops existing.

skipIfAlreadyMet.description: If the objective already holds when the step would open, complete it silently: no brief, no popup. For the player who did it before being asked.

pending.description: What is finishing without the player while this step is open, each with the thing it will give them. Shown on the objective card and in the return digest.

letter.description: An inbox letter sent from the speaker when the step completes, through the existing message store.
